name: Sewer Centipede
body:
Sewer Centipede
CR 1

XP 400
N Small vermin
Init +3; Senses blindsense 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 13 (2d8+4)
Fort +5, Ref +3, Will +0
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 40 ft.
Melee bite +3 (1d4+1 plus poison)
Special Attacks poison

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 17, Con 15, Int —, Wis 10, Cha 2
Base Atk +1; CMB +1; CMD 14 (can’t be tripped)
Skills Climb +9, Perception +4, Stealth +15; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +8 Stealth
SQ compression

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 13; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Dex damage; cure 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or warm forest or underground
Organization solitary, pair, or colony (3–6)
Treasure none
